source: BF16 development-oracle stage timings; sensitivity inputs, not target-platform measurements
notes: Zero fixed latency is a serialization lower bound and is deliberately optimistic.
Power values are sensitivity assumptions, not A6000, ZCU102 or future-platform measurements.
Only measured visual-prefix block time is assigned to the accelerator; preprocessing and vision_other remain on the host.
Decode and postprocessing are excluded because these paths are unchanged by visual-token selection.
